mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when I use AI to develop a product?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI-generated content can be inaccurate, repetitive, biased, or poorly matched to customer needs, and confidential information may be exposed if tools are used carelessly. Treat AI output as a draft requiring review, not as verified expertise. Run My AI Business emphasizes source checking, secure account connections, and restrictions against inventing statistics, proof, or income claims. Key factors: data sensitivity, source quality, model limitations, permissions, and the consequences of an error. Practical guidance: create a review checklist, avoid unnecessary confidential data, and require approval before publishing, sending messages, spending money, or signing up for services.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI may produce incorrect facts, generic content, biased recommendations, privacy problems, or a product nobody wants. Reduce risk with verified sources, limited data access, review checklists, user testing, and approval gates before publication, purchases, outreach, or account changes.
